prompt:
Create a new KFB claymation ink blob sheet, The School Keeps Running. Use the original reference PNGs for the established organic full-body ink monster morphology and modeling. Exactly six whole independent standalone dark charcoal-plum goo figures, three columns and two rows, landscape 1536×1024 true transparent PNG. Every face is sculpted directly into its continuous organic blob. Think six different compact asymmetrical drips, rounded pears, commas and irregular splats, as varied as the original family. Maintain each individual silhouette, with natural soft little lobes at the sides and bottom, sometimes no distinct foot shape. A short round or tapered bottom is welcome. Do not use a standard flared base, wide flat skirt, common lobe row, humanoid chest or cut-off bust. Clothing is just a small removable accessory and props sit close to the side or belly with the lower body visible. Thick sculpted dark lids, white sclera, red iris and black pupil. Soft satin clay, sparse broad hand modeling marks, distinct moods, tiny ink hands. No inherited costume, wing or eyepatch, scenery, floor, shadow, frame or text beyond specified prop marks. Preserve generous transparent separation and exterior margin. School-house navy, muted pine, ochre and cream. Small removable props rather than full uniforms.
Row-major roles:
1. Male-read school principal. tall wide-bottom ink drop, composed lifted lids. Key cue: one small brass handbell and a slim folder held to the side.
2. Male-read caretaker. wide square splat with soft lobes, tired sideways gaze. Key cue: short oversized keyring with three visibly different keys.
3. Female-read school cleaner. upright comma, determined eyes and sharp small smile. Key cue: small hand mop with a short handle and little bright bucket at flank.
4. Female-read school cook. broad scalloped blob, patient amused eyes. Key cue: stubby ladle and a small food bowl.
5. Male-read school crossing guard. narrow pear with wavy base, watchful raised eyebrows. Key cue: one short crossing paddle with simple white stripes and a slim reflective sash.
6. Male-read school office clerk. low bean, precise narrowed eyes, pursed lips. Key cue: small wooden date stamp with blank base and two cream slips.
Each actor has a distinct complete compact ink contour from crown to lower edge and one clean readable subject or role prop.
